event: Under Law No. 27 of 2026 on Worker Protection, the Ministry of Manpower set follow-on 2027 minimum-wage deadlines after the 21 November UMP deadline: UMK by 25 November, UMSP on 26 November and UMSK by 30 November. (update of E0921)
key_numbers: UMP deadline 21 Nov 2026 · UMK 25 Nov · UMSP 26 Nov · UMSK 30 Nov · index value 0.5-1.0 in formula · 3 variables: KHL, economic conditions, employment

event: Former Polhukam minister Mahfud MD urged President Prabowo and MPR leaders to be careful in setting the schedule for choosing Gibran's replacement as Vice President. (update of E0898)
key_numbers: MPR plenary moved from 2 Dec to 9 Dec 2026 · Mahfud statement 21 Nov 2026 01:01 WIB

event: The one-week deadline Prabowo gave coalition party leaders at the 13 Nov Bogor Palace meeting to prepare vice-presidential nominee names fell around 20 Nov; parties are to be invited again after his overseas trip. (update of E0898)
key_numbers: Meeting 13 Nov 2026 · deadline about 1 week · PAN's Zulkifli Hasan says PAN will not field a cadre through 2029 and suggests a Gerindra figure

event: Polri says the ethics hearing (KKEP) of former Kapolri Listyo Sigit over the alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo will be held the following week; exact day and panel not yet announced. (update of E0955)
key_numbers: Hearing 'next week' per Polri spokesperson (reported 17 Nov 2026) · Irjen Ahrie Sonta already given PTDH (dishonourable discharge) in a related case · Sigit named a suspect

event: A legal observer said the newly passed Asset Forfeiture Law would let the state seize crime-derived assets even if moved to family or companies, and noted some provisions could be challenged at the Constitutional Court. (update of E0953)
key_numbers: Passed by DPR plenary 19 Nov 2026 · reportedly takes effect about 1 year after passage · protects good-faith third parties

event: KPK questioned BNPB Secretary-General Rustian again as a witness in the disaster emergency-fund (DSP) corruption case, probing direct appointment of private vendors and kickbacks.
key_numbers: 5 suspects · alleged bribes Rp 4.8 billion + 325 grams of gold + SGD/USD sums · earlier 7-hour examination on 27 Oct 2026

event: Green SM Bike, the Vietnamese VinFast-backed electric ride-hailing service launched in Jakarta in September 2026, officially stopped operating in Indonesia on 20 November, per CNBC Indonesia.
key_numbers: Service stopped 20 Nov 2026 · launched Sept 2026 with 75% launch discounts (Katadata) · driver fallout not verified

event: CNBC Indonesia reported about 4,000 retired civil servants were hit by hacking and that their pension funds are at risk.
key_numbers: ~4,000 retired civil servants affected (headline figure) · amounts not verified

event: Credit card data of Visa and Mastercard holders was reported leaked and circulated online, per CNBC Indonesia.
key_numbers: Visa and Mastercard card data leaked online · volume and Indonesian exposure not verified

event: Komdigi summoned Google to discuss the closure of 19,389 YouTube accounts linked to Indonesia, after Google removed channels tied to pro-government influence operations. (update of E0969)
key_numbers: 19,389 YouTube accounts closed (CNBC Indonesia) · Komdigi summons Google 20 Nov · Google earlier cited 10,134 channels for one batch (Bisnis, 18 Nov)

event: CNBC Indonesia reported that people are reluctant to buy new phones in 2026 and phone sellers are struggling to sell.
key_numbers: Qualitative report; sales figures not verified · earlier CNBC (19 Oct) said rising smartphone prices cut demand

event: CNBC Indonesia reported that old phones will be blocked from WhatsApp if owners ignore warnings about unsupported OS versions.
key_numbers: Models/cutoff dates not verified

event: CNBC Indonesia reported that Google will make major changes in January 2027 that could suddenly block some phone apps.
key_numbers: Effective January 2027 · details not verified

key_numbers: Launch 20 Nov 2026 · details not verified

key_numbers: Rp104.3 trillion losses · WhatsApp most common channel

event: West Jakarta police detailed how a PIK security guard climbing onto a car hood led to two narcotics officers being assaulted on the Sedyatmo toll road on 19 November. (update of E0972)

event: Bareskrim searched five houses in Bogor and Curug (Tangerang) in a treason (makar) case naming Brigjen Muhammad Tedjo Kusumo and Kombes Iman Imanudin, and postponed the case presentation with Kejagung to next week. (update of E0940)
key_numbers: 5 houses searched since evening 19 Nov · ekspose with Kejagung moved from 20 Nov to the following week · wiretap case: 4 suspects, 3 detained at Rutan Mako Brimob

event: MPR started verifying documents of vice-presidential candidates to replace Gibran, while Mahfud MD argued the 9 December election could be invalid if held as planned. (update of E0898)

event: Polri denied reports that the alleged rape case against Kupang Regent Yosef Lede ended in a settlement, and police have questioned more than a dozen witnesses. (update of E0973)

event: Weather modification started in Aceh to shift rain out to sea after weeks of floods. (update of E0910)
key_numbers: Details (agency, aircraft, duration) not verified, headline only · earlier BPBA count: 21,109 affected in five regencies/cities (17 Nov)

event: The Siantar Ekspres train caught fire after hitting a minibus (angkot), injuring three railway staff.
